rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The PT portal says on 9 July 2005 that José Genoino's request to step away ('pedido de afastamento') from the PT presidency is seen as a decision serving the party, and that he had just announced it at the National Directorate meeting in São Paulo to allow the party leadership to be recomposed.
